name: royal-navy-osint-fleet-map
description: Browser-based map of last publicly reported Royal Navy and RFA vessel locations.

scripts.test: node scripts/test-loader.mjs && node scripts/test-provenance.mjs && node scripts/test-map.mjs && node scripts/test-photos.mjs && node scripts/test-release.mjs
scripts.build: npm run generate:public && npm run validate:data && npm test && vite build && node scripts/copy-fleet-data.mjs && node scripts/check-client-exposure.mjs
scripts.build:pages: npm run generate:public && npm run validate:data && npm test && vite build --base=/royal-navy-fleet-status/ && node scripts/copy-fleet-data.mjs && node scripts/test-pages-build.mjs && node scripts/check-client-exposure.mjs
